data.one_liner: Resolves file names and paths of dynamic libraries across platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides helpers to resolve the correct file names and paths for dynamic libraries on Android, iOS, Linux, macOS, and Windows. It integrates with dart-define and environment variables to allow custom library paths.
use_when: You are using dart:ffi to load dynamic libraries across multiple platforms
You need to handle platform-specific library naming conventions (.so, .dylib, .dll)
avoid_when: Your application does not use native C/C++ interop via dart:ffi
strengths: Supports custom paths via environment variables and dart-defines
weaknesses: Not documented for complex custom bundling strategies
